strings.zh: 这里是以口袋竞技的历史和{NEWLINE}以精灵和人类的{CLEAR}相互帮助为主题的{SCROLL}「协力」的房间。
strings.en: This is the “Solidarity” room.{SCROLL}It is to show the solidarity of Pokémon{NEWLINE}and people, as well as the history{CLEAR}of the Pokéathlon.

strings.zh: 这个前面是{NEWLINE}单人用的５条线路,{CLEAR}只有各项都取得胜利的{CLEAR}非常优秀的口袋竞技员{CLEAR}才能进去。
strings.en: Only the Pokéathletes who have{NEWLINE}come in first in five of the courses{CLEAR}are allowed here.

strings.zh: 在这个前面就是「信赖」的房间{NEWLINE}请通过。
strings.en: Ahead is the “Trust” room.{NEWLINE}Please go on through.
strings.notes: US 0140/2 | RV039: meaning: the room is ahead, not this one

strings.zh: 口袋竞技有着悠久历史啊。
strings.en: The Pokéathlon does go way back.

strings.zh: 线路上取胜的话{NEWLINE}就能得到奖牌！{CLEAR}要取得全线路的胜利哦！{SCROLL}
strings.en: When you win a course,{NEWLINE}you receive a Medal!{CLEAR}I’ve got to win at every course!{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 取得了很好的记录,{NEWLINE}口袋竞技员会{SCROLL}在博物馆展示鞋子等物品！
strings.en: Pokéathletes who set great records get{NEWLINE}their shoes and other things displayed{CLEAR}in the museum!
strings.notes: US 0140/5 | RV039: addition: I heard was added

strings.zh: 非常陈旧的壁画{SCROLL}一个人类和３只精灵{CLEAR}正听着从天上{CLEAR}传来的什么指导。
strings.en: It’s a very old wall painting.{SCROLL}One person and three Pokémon are{NEWLINE}listening to some guidance coming from{CLEAR}the sky.
strings.notes: US 0140/7 | RV039: meaning: listening to guidance from the sky (D-1716)

strings.zh: 破烂的卷轴{SCROLL}「口袋竞技的传说{SCROLL}　一个人类和{NEWLINE}　３只精灵{CLEAR}　为了治愈在{CLEAR}　岛上扩散的病症,{CLEAR}　跨越了１０个障碍,{CLEAR}　到处传授治愈传染病{CLEAR}　的方法⋯⋯
strings.en: It’s a tattered scroll.{SCROLL}“Legend of the Pokéathlon{SCROLL}To cure a disease spreading across the{NEWLINE}island, one person and three Pokémon{CLEAR}overcame ten obstacles and taught the{CLEAR}cure for the plague far and wide...”
strings.notes: US 0140/8 | RV039: meaning: aligned to zh (legend; taught the cure everywhere)

strings.zh: 古老的卷轴{SCROLL}「口袋竞技成立{SCROLL}　传授了治疗法{NEWLINE}　为了歌颂人类和３只精灵{CLEAR}　的友情,他们被作为{CLEAR}　英雄而被世代传颂{SCROLL}　⋯⋯　⋯⋯　⋯⋯{NEWLINE}　人人都歌颂英雄{SCROLL}　开始模仿英雄{NEWLINE}　走过的{CLEAR}　１０个障碍⋯⋯
strings.en: It’s an old scroll.{SCROLL}“The Founding of the Pokéathlon{SCROLL}To celebrate the friendship of the{NEWLINE}person and three Pokémon who taught{CLEAR}the cure, they were praised as heroes{CLEAR}for generations.{SCROLL}... Everyone praised the heroes{SCROLL}and began to imitate the ten obstacles{NEWLINE}the heroes had overcome...”
strings.notes: US 0140/9 | RV039: omission: heroes for generations dropped

strings.zh: 「口袋竞技花名册⋯⋯{SCROLL}很多的口袋竞技员和{NEWLINE}得奖精灵以{CLEAR}照片的形式被介绍。
strings.en: “Pokéathlon Almanac”{SCROLL}There are many Pokéathletes and{NEWLINE}Pokémon Medalists shown in{CLEAR}the photos.{NEWLINE}
